rule: var(--color-accent) must not be used as the sole color signal for normal-weight body text smaller than 18.67 px. Light-mode contrast: #d94f63 = 3.37:1, #d35b2d = 3.55:1 (bg #f6f2ee). Dark-mode contrast: #f07585 = 4.9:1 (surface #241c1a). Passes WCAG 2.1 AA for large/bold text (>=18.67px normal or >=14px bold) but light-mode fails for normal body text. Any rule that fails on either mode is flagged ADVISORY.

Pass 2 — CSS rule blocks in project stylesheet(s)
Pass 3 — Hardcoded hex text colors inside dark-mode CSS blocks
